# betas.extraction.estimate_betas { #fmrimod.betas.extraction.estimate_betas }

```python
estimate_betas(
    trial_regressors,
    Y,
    method='lss',
    confounds=None,
    nuisance_projector=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    trial_labels=None,
    baseline_regressors=None,
    include_intercept=False,
)
```

Estimate trial-wise betas.

.. deprecated::
    Use :func:`fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial` instead.

Dispatcher for OLS and LSS beta estimation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                                  | Description                                                      | Default    |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| trial_regressors    | NDArray, shape ``(n_time, n_trials)`` | Per-trial design columns (already convolved with HRF).           | _required_ |
| Y                   | NDArray, shape ``(n_time, V)``        | Data matrix.                                                     | _required_ |
| method              | [str](`str`)                          | ``"ols"`` or ``"lss"`` (default).                                | `'lss'`    |
| confounds           | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)     | Nuisance regressors.                                             | `None`     |
| nuisance_projector  | [object](`object`)                    | Precomputed nuisance projector for LSS.                          | `None`     |
| chunk_size          | [int](`int`)                          | Voxel chunk size for beta-only LSS solves.                       | `None`     |
| trial_labels        | sequence of str                       | Labels for each trial.                                           | `None`     |
| baseline_regressors | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)     | Baseline or experimental regressors included in every LSS model. | `None`     |
| include_intercept   | [bool](`bool`)                        | Add an intercept to the LSS adjustment design.                   | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description   |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | [BetaResult](`fmrimod.betas.extraction.BetaResult`) |               |
